assault._comment: CORRECTED 2026-07-31. This field counts anomaly_tick events across the WHOLE rotation, not procs per Assault instance, and the two are different claims. The Leifa citation supports 'one Assault instance deals 1 proc' — it says nothing about how many instances a 3x Dancing Blades rotation produces. The previous value of 1 was frozen while the simulator silently swallowed same-element re-triggers (fixed in #145), so the two claims coincided by accident and the fixture recorded the bug as truth. This rotation legitimately crosses the physical threshold twice: instances land at t=0.30 and t=3.30, exactly the 3.0s per-attribute anomaly cooldown apart, i.e. the second fires at the first legal instant. Per-instance damage is unchanged at 710 — the same formula-derived value this fixture already documents — so only the count moved.
